protocol.objective: sample mean strain energy + gamma times sample standard deviation
protocol.constraints: same robust statistic for mass and two buckling margins
protocol.uncertainty_independence: all four source classes are mutually independent
protocol.mc_failure_policy: abort candidate and run; no failed sample is discarded
protocol.surrogate: random-tree additive ARD Matern-5/2 SAAS-GP with NUTS marginalization
protocol.acquisition: edge-factorized LCB minimized on graph anchors inside an L-infinity trust region

embedding.normalization: component-wise min-max before and after Isomap
